about: Boasts, threats and alarms (owner ruling: arrogance, anger and fear). Structure only, no sentences: every line is a part of data/english/parts/stance.json. A stance is raised by a person from a recorded moment of theirs; how sharply they say it is read from their traits through the shared trait-act table (trait-act-pulls.json), never rolled.
levelsNote: A slide of four bands of the speaker's lean, edge-0 (plain) to edge-3 (rude). The lean itself is continuous (traitLeanBetween, -1 to 1); the bands only choose which authored wordings are in reach.
